title: The complete profiled common-covariance location-mixture class has coefficient h_g^prof

coefficient_rigidity.mixture_energy: Potential expectations are linear under mixing and q_0=I_Omega/4, so Q_N(pi)=E_pi E_N(A,S_N)-(U-I_Omega(nu_pi|mu))/4.
coefficient_rigidity.component_lower: K1572's larger-root profiled Gaussian is the finite-cutoff global stationary diagonal Gaussian minimum, hence every component with mean A e_0 and common S_N has E_N(A,S_N)>=lambda_N^prof.
coefficient_rigidity.class_lower: K1596 gives Q_N(pi)>=lambda_N^prof-(1/4)sqrt(omega_0^2+kappa_(g,N)^+) for every finite-second-moment location law pi.
coefficient_rigidity.class_upper: K1591's symmetric profiled cat belongs to the class and has Q_N^cat<=lambda_N^prof.
coefficient_rigidity.coefficient: Therefore lambda_N^prof-O_g(N)<=inf_pi Q_N(pi)<=lambda_N^prof and inf_pi Q_N(pi)/N^4->h_g^prof.
coefficient_rigidity.route_consequence: Arbitrarily many zero-mode locations and arbitrarily negative fourth-cumulant defects inside this common-covariance class cannot lower the N^4 coefficient; a coefficient-changing route must leave the class.
coefficient_rigidity.scope_guard: This is a class-infimum theorem, not an unrestricted ground-energy coefficient, a bounded-error recentering theorem, or control of heterogeneous covariances, spatial textures, phases or nonstationary laws.
